cli.help.overview: fresnel: interactive agent runtime Usage: fresnel [common flags] [command] [arguments] Commands chat Interactive mode (default). Switches to print mode when the terminal is not interactive chat -p Print mode: run one turn with this input and write the reply to stdout -p - or a bare -p reads all of stdin as the input chat -p --quiet Do not write the one-line usage summary to stderr at the end chat -p --json JSON mode: write the JSON-RPC messages exchanged with the engine, one per line chat -p --auto-approve Print mode: approve a tool call once. Questions, plans, and reviews are declined chat --continue Resume the last conversation in the current working folder chat --resume Resume the given conversation chat --set = Override a setting for this conversation only (can be repeated) sessions ls [--all] [--limit n] [--offset n] [--json] sessions show [--json] sessions fork [--at ] sessions rm [--yes] List, show, fork, and delete conversations sessions rename Change the conversation title (200 characters or fewer) config get [<key>…] Show the effective values and where they come from config schema --scope <managed|user|project|local> [--out <path>] [--core-only] Write the JSON Schema for the settings files config set <key> <value> [--scope user|project|local] config reset <key> [--scope user|project|local] config list [--prefix <p>] [--deprecated] [--json] Set, clear, and list settings secret ls|add|set|meta|rotate|rm|test|reveal Manage secrets. Values are read only from a prompt or stdin. Use reveal only in a terminal trust [status] [--json] Show the work folder trust state for this working folder, and the choices trust list [--json] List the folders that were trusted or denied (read only) trust allow|deny [--scope folder|parent|session] Send a trust decision. When trusted, .mcp.json, project skills, and project commands are read db export <folder> [--json] [--yes] Export the storage files read-only, without the engine. The engine may be running db restore <folder> [--json] Restore a database from an export. Close the engine first. Secrets need the age key separately db usage [--json] Show the disk use of the data folder and the engine logs. Writes nothing and does not start the engine db previous-rm <name> [--yes] [--json] Delete one pre-restore copy. The names are listed by db usage. cli.help.topic.db:
Usage: fresnel db export <folder> [--json] [--yes]
       fresnel db restore <folder> [--json]
       fresnel db usage [--json]
       fresnel db previous-rm <name> [--yes] [--json]

  <folder>      Folder to export to. It is created if it is missing. If it exists, it must be empty. A relative path is based on the working folder (-C)
  --json        Write the export result (destDir, exportedAt, blobCount, missingBlobs) as JSON
  --yes         Skip the confirmation. The copy may contain secret values in plain text. Without a terminal this flag is required
  <name>        The name of a pre-restore copy, as listed under previous by db usage (for example 20261107T123456789Z)

  Creates <folder>/fresnel.sqlite, <folder>/blobs/, and <folder>/manifest.json. The engine is not started.

  restore puts an export back in place of the current database. It verifies the backup first, refuses while an engine is running, refuses a backup from a newer version, and keeps the current database in <data directory>/restore-previous/. Run it again if it was interrupted.
  Secrets are not in the backup: the age key (secrets/age/keys.txt in the app data on a new install, or the Keychain item fresnel.age on an older one) and the config file are not copied. Keep the age key separately.
  usage shows the disk use of the data folder and the engine logs. It writes nothing.
  previous-rm deletes the whole copy folder. This cannot be undone.
cli.help.topic.schedule:
Usage: fresnel schedule add <prompt…> (--every <seconds> | --at <time> | --remote | --watch <path>[,<path>…] | --loop <seconds> --max-iterations <n> --expires-in <seconds>)
                       [--title <title>] [--workspace <folder>] [--disabled]
       fresnel schedule list [--all] [--json]
       fresnel schedule cancel <id>
       fresnel schedule run <id>

  --every <seconds>      Run the prompt in a new conversation every this many seconds. The minimum is 300 seconds
  --at <time>            Run once at an RFC 3339 time
  --remote               Does not run on a schedule. Run it now with fresnel schedule run <id>
  --watch <path>[,…]     Run when a path changes. Waits for --debounce <ms> (default 1000) before running
  --loop <seconds>       Repeat the same prompt. Give --max-iterations and --expires-in with it
  --title <title>        Title shown in the list (200 characters or fewer)
  --workspace <folder>   Working folder of the run conversation. If it is omitted, the default folder of the host is used
  --disabled             Create it, but leave it turned off
  --remote is a trigger flag. Give the remote service address before the command (fresnel --remote <address> schedule list)
  Schedules run while the app or the service is running. Quitting the app (⌘Q) stops them, and closing only its window does not. If neither is running they are only saved, and one warning line is shown
